title: KAYFABE demo update: UI fixes, a new trailer, and feedback on AI-assisted portrait consistency
author: laughing_gorilla123
selftext:
I shared KAYFABE's browser demo here a couple of days ago. Today's build fixes roster alignment, popularity displays, booking portraits, English text, and some records labels. I've also put together a new trailer using the updated game screens.



KAYFABE is a solo-developed wrestling management sim about a small promotion and the people keeping it alive. The demo covers your first three shows: book the cards, manage money, and deal with life backstage.



AI tools are used only for illustrations and coding. Wrestler portraits start from AI-generated images and are converted into pixel art; some backgrounds use edited AI drafts. Sound effects come from real recordings. No generative AI runs during gameplay.



One thing I'd like feedback on is whether the portraits and backgrounds feel like they belong in the same game when viewed inside these busy management screens. I'd also like to know where the opening leaves you unsure what to do next, especially if you don't follow wrestling. How do you check visual consistency across a large cast when working with AI-assisted art?



Free browser demo: [https://forty-slop.itch.io/kayfabe-demo](https://forty-slop.itch.io/kayfabe-demo)

New trailer: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9jwQl3k9rW8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9jwQl3k9rW8)

Steam wishlist: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5389060/KAYFABE/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5389060/KAYFABE/)



English and Korean are supported. Japanese is still partially untranslated. Thanks for trying it—bug reports and blunt feedback are welcome.
